newsitem.title: SPAIN: CNMV lifts trade suspension on Bankoa.
newsitem.headline: CNMV lifts trade suspension on Bankoa.

text.p: Spain's stock market watchdog CNMV said on Wednesday it had lifted its suspension on trade on banking group Bankoa effective Thursday.
Bankoa is traded on the open outcry system on the Madrid bourse and is not screen traded.
On Monday the CNMV authorised a bid by Sociedad Cooperativa de Credito Caja Rural Vasca to buy 100 percent of Bankoa at 3,000 pesetas per share.
Caja Rural is also offering 8.0 billion pesetas in public debt as backing for the deal.
